title: Food illustration film

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is a poster frame

slide_intent: Animate familiar eating gestures so illustration conveys pleasure and playfulness rather than serving as decoration alone.
strategic_value: Hands, faces and food transformations can make Burger King’s playful character recognizable in motion.
demonstration: The clip sequences a tomato, dipping fries, a burger held and bitten, onion rings, fries at a mouth, ice cream and faces playing with food.
practical_value: Compare how simple graphic actions carry sensory ideas without photorealism.

content_islands.name: Ingredients and handling
content_islands.spec: Begin with a hand and tomato, then move through dipping and holding food.

content_islands.name: Eating and play
content_islands.spec: Show a bitten burger and playful uses of rings and fries.

content_islands.name: People and treats
content_islands.spec: Finish with illustrated faces and ice-cream gestures across changing color fields.

reference_purposes.Expression: The full clip animates flat food illustrations through holding, dipping, biting and playful facial gestures.
